title: Implement direct signed carry streams for BIT high routes
body:
## Change

PR2915 expands a negative high-field carry into repeated sign/shift/sign calls. This adds an opt-in encoded stream rotation with complete prefix/suffix preservation, distinct output ownership and erased private buckets. The +1 path stays with the existing implementation after a tiny-packet comparison exposed a setup regression there.

The −4 kernel fixture (486 bits) uses 54,064 physical tape operations instead of 1,105,367, a 95.1% reduction. A complete signed-scale route uses 410,237 instead of 881,379, a 53.5% reduction. Three alternating fresh-process Python 3.12 benchmark pairs give median instrumented execution speedups of 19.68× and 2.13× respectively. Setup, rewinds, cleanup and native intervals are measured; these are reference fixtures, not multiplication timings.

## Scope and evidence

The written source argument gives `O(BQS + I)` complete local work, eight additional scratch roles and zero numerical words for the direct kernel. The opt-in adapter preserves the predecessor execute lifecycle except for carry dispatch. Frozen sources, the default adapter, recursive native calls, selected record and κ are unchanged.

Verification covers 96 complete before/after kernel pairs, seven complete route pairs, 2,056 independent modular split identities, full input-column provenance, borrowed/dirty state, source corruption, extra input, wrong direction on all-zero payloads, one-role-short allocation and endpoint-preserving extra traffic. The selected registry census covers all 1,123 chart types and 2,246 orientations at q=3 and identity low class: 34,450,048 old full-field primitive calls become 11,858,368 kernel calls. This specialization is not a runtime ratio or a complete GL64 payload execution.

Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`. Executable/archive source pins and complete typed receipts are in `research/high-carry-streams/`. Reproduce with:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-carry-streams
```

Expected: all four `PASS_HIGH_CARRY_*` suites and successful registered replay. `VALIDATION.md` records the committed replay, source-export checks and benchmark environment. Whole-caller backing/stock, native refinement, formal verification and supplier admission remain separate obligations. Concurrent #3340's fitted-B1 bridge is complementary and unused.

## Credit

Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml supplied #2915's executor, kernels and registry and #2899's backend; David Arias supplied #2753. The physical observer follows #3330. Retain Nick Petalas, commdata2338, Sagar Thakrar, Arham Tahir, ywz65, Ross Richardson and Krzysztof Wójt's cost and caller work and the #2157/#589/#555 lineage. Tekalign (`tekuuu`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New material is Apache-2.0; no independent human review is claimed.
